summary.tldr: Amends the Criminal Code to create criminal liability for some violent crimes committed during negligent self-induced intoxication.
what_it_does: Amends the Criminal Code to provide for criminal liability for violent crimes of general intent committed by a person while in a state of negligent self-induced intoxication.
summary.background: The Minister of Justice introduced Bill C-28 in the House of Commons on 17 June 2022, and it received first reading.
